description: This file defines the 'MeetingReadPlatformService' interface in the org.apache.fineract.portfolio.meeting.service package, specifying methods for retrieving meeting data.

classes.name: MeetingReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface providing methods to read and retrieve meeting-related data in the Fineract portfolio module.

methods.name: retrieveMeeting
methods.description: Retrieve details of a specific meeting by its ID, associated entity ID, and entity type.

methods.name: retrieveMeetingsByEntity
methods.description: Retrieve a collection of meetings associated with a specific entity, limited by the specified count.

methods.name: retrieveMeetingsByEntityByCalendarType
methods.description: Retrieve meetings for an entity filtered by a list of calendar type options.

methods.name: retrieveLastMeeting
methods.description: Retrieve the most recent meeting for a given calendar instance.
